title: Program wire — the toy witness's effect (§10.6)
description: The toy's one effect, as a toy step trace records it: a STRING whose contents are these bytes, members in the order `kind`, `nodeId`, `volume`. The toy's effect adopts §5.2's envelope — a `kind` discriminator and the emitter's member order — because a trace compares effects byte-for-byte as emitted, for the reason §10.3 gives. That the three members coincide with Ordinal order is an accident of their names, and `wire-fixtures/check-scenarios.mjs` checks the ORDER, which a schema cannot.
